entries.title: Gravity-Driven Ball Sorting Ramp
entries.description: A 3D system of sloped transparent chutes where colored spheres roll down, collide with pegs, and are sorted into labeled bins by size and color, with trails showing their paths and counters above each bin.
entries.seed: Gravity-Driven Ball Sorting Ramp: A 3D system of sloped transparent chutes where colored spheres roll down, collide with pegs, and are sorted into labeled bins by size and color, with trails showing their paths and counters above each bin.

entries.title: Robotic Arm Package Sorter
entries.description: A network of conveyor belts carries differently sized boxes while robotic arms pivot, grab, and place them into color-coded platforms based on labels on their sides, with glowing lines briefly attaching arm grippers to boxes during transfer.
entries.seed: Robotic Arm Package Sorter: A network of conveyor belts carries differently sized boxes while robotic arms pivot, grab, and place them into color-coded platforms based on labels on their sides, with glowing lines briefly attaching arm grippers to boxes during transfer.

entries.title: Air-Jet Particle Sorter
entries.description: Tiny particles fall through a clear vertical chamber and get deflected left or right by timed air jets that push them into separate tubes by mass (light ones float further), with swirling dust particles and digital meters counting each output stream.
entries.seed: Air-Jet Particle Sorter: Tiny particles fall through a clear vertical chamber and get deflected left or right by timed air jets that push them into separate tubes by mass (light ones float further), with swirling dust particles and digital meters counting each output stream.

entries.title: Magnetic Recycling Sort Line
entries.description: Mixed metal and plastic objects move along a belt over spinning magnetic drums that attract and lift ferrous pieces up into one chute while non-magnetic items continue into others, with visible magnetic field lines and colored halos around attracted items.
entries.seed: Magnetic Recycling Sort Line: Mixed metal and plastic objects move along a belt over spinning magnetic drums that attract and lift ferrous pieces up into one chute while non-magnetic items continue into others, with visible magnetic field lines and colored halos around attracted items.

entries.title: Floating Bubble Color Sorter
entries.description: Semi-transparent bubbles of different colors rise in a tall water column where rotating paddles and gentle currents nudge them into matching-colored ring gates that glow when the correct bubble passes through.
entries.seed: Floating Bubble Color Sorter: Semi-transparent bubbles of different colors rise in a tall water column where rotating paddles and gentle currents nudge them into matching-colored ring gates that glow when the correct bubble passes through.

entries.title: Size-Based Marble Sieve Tower
entries.description: A vertical stack of vibrating sieve plates with decreasing hole sizes lets marbles drop and bounce from level to level until they get trapped in the first plate that can’t pass them, with each level color-coded and labeled from largest to smallest.
entries.seed: Size-Based Marble Sieve Tower: A vertical stack of vibrating sieve plates with decreasing hole sizes lets marbles drop and bounce from level to level until they get trapped in the first plate that can’t pass them, with each level color-coded and labeled from largest to smallest.

entries.title: DNA Strand Sorting Nanobot Swarm
entries.description: In a translucent cell-like chamber, short colored “DNA” rods drift while tiny nanobots orbit, scan, and then attach to specific color patterns, towing matching rods into separate glowing compartments that seal behind them.
entries.seed: DNA Strand Sorting Nanobot Swarm: In a translucent cell-like chamber, short colored “DNA” rods drift while tiny nanobots orbit, scan, and then attach to specific color patterns, towing matching rods into separate glowing compartments that seal behind them.

entries.title: Airport Luggage Carousel Sorter
entries.description: Suitcases with different colored tags ride on intersecting conveyor loops while overhead scanners flash and trigger diverter arms that rotate and push each bag down a ramp to the correct carousel, with floating label text above each moving bag.
entries.seed: Airport Luggage Carousel Sorter: Suitcases with different colored tags ride on intersecting conveyor loops while overhead scanners flash and trigger diverter arms that rotate and push each bag down a ramp to the correct carousel, with floating label text above each moving bag.

entries.title: Branching River Sediment Sorter
entries.description: A transparent riverbed model shows water carrying particles of sand, gravel, and pebbles that settle and slide differently as the flow splits around rocks; heavier particles drop into deeper channels while lighter ones continue, forming layered bars.
entries.seed: Branching River Sediment Sorter: A transparent riverbed model shows water carrying particles of sand, gravel, and pebbles that settle and slide differently as the flow splits around rocks; heavier particles drop into deeper channels while lighter ones continue, forming layered bars.

entries.description: Shards of space debris orbit a central planet while adjustable ring-shaped “capture orbits” glow and gently attract objects of specific mass and velocity, causing some to spiral in and others to be flung outward into labeled orbital bands.
entries.seed: Planetary Debris Orbital Sorter: Shards of space debris orbit a central planet while adjustable ring-shaped “capture orbits” glow and gently attract objects of specific mass and velocity, causing some to spiral in and others to be flung outward into labeled orbital bands.

entries.title: Sound Wave Ball Sorting Tunnel

entries.description: Computer chips levitate slightly over a circular track using magnetic fields; as the track rotates, electromagnets pulse on and off to pull different chip types into radial lanes, where they slide inward and stack into neat columns.

entries.description: In multiple side-by-side transparent columns, gas bubbles of different sizes rise through viscous liquid, merging, splitting, and changing speed; baffles and angled plates guide different bubble sizes into separate collection chambers at the top.

entries.description: In a slowly cooling transparent solution, different colored ions drift and then either attach to a growing central crystal or are repelled and drift into side collectors, visually separating “pure” and “impurity” particles by their bonding behavior.
